mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in payroll employment growth above 200k signals rising household income and consumer spending, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when PAYEMS growth exceeds 200k for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month decline in the Housing Starts Index exceeding 10% signals weakening residential investment and lower construction-related earnings, which reduces S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when HOUST declines > 10% over 6 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in the Industrial Production Index above 0.5% signals stronger manufacturing activity and higher corporate revenues, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when INDPRO growth exceeds 0.5% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 4% signals labor market tightness and upward wage pressure, which reduces corporate margins and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when UNRATE falls below 4% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures above 2% signals weakening consumer demand and lower corporate revenues, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when RSAFS declines > 2% over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in payroll employment growth above 200k combined with a 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 4% signals labor market tightness and upward wage pressure, which reduces corporate margins and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth > 200k for 3 months AND UNRATE < 4% for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when both PAYEMS growth exceeds 200k and UNRATE falls below 4% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).
